snippet.title: Hawthorn - Official Demo Release Date Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Demo Release Date Trailer for Hawthorn, a fantasy sandbox multiplayer RPG developed by NEARstudios. Players will build a village, acquaint other anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures, and explore the sprawling scenery. Hawthorn is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo launching on June 15 as part of Steam Next Fest.
